transforms.name: adapter-step-0
transforms.effect: cost_usd is copied when it is a non-negative finite number, including 0. A missing or negative value omits costUsd.

transforms.name: adapter-step-1
transforms.effect: The event does not set cost coverage, burnPerHour, or a series.

renderer.symbol: priced working body and spend series

applicability.notes: Source-permitted, conditional, not live-observed. Provider-reported costUsd wins, including zero. Missing cost can still be catalog-priced when pricing buckets and the model key are complete. Normal backend emits field.cost only for complete or partial. state.cost_unavailable is not produced by that mapping. state.cost_missing remains possible before any priced total. Priced flames 0-4 are possible on an observed working body; the tier is not chosen here. PENDING DOWNSTREAM MAPPING into MonitorAgentRow. This is one of 74 canonical row fields. It is not an SDK contract leaf. PENDING DOWNSTREAM MAPPING: GV-AUDIT2 owns adapter output to row predicates, including cost, burn rate, history, timeline, and git branch. This audit does not give that verdict. Schema acceptance is not complete provenance. verification.status source-read is a static reading. observation.presence unknown means no live sample was taken. It does not mean the row value is missing. classification.adapterEmittable and uiReachable stay unknown. A raw adapter property is not the row field, and a catalog consumer is not a proven UI path.  This record does not emit state.cost_complete, state.cost_partial, state.cost_unavailable, state.cost_missing, state.burn_flames_0, state.burn_flames_1, state.burn_flames_2, state.burn_flames_3, state.burn_flames_4, or state.burn_unpriced. Those predicates stay downstream. PENDING DOWNSTREAM MAPPING. field.cost.usd, coverage, burnPerHour, and series are backend ledger fields. Only a request cost number is emitted, and only when the attribute parses. Mapping onto coverage is pending. The adapter does not write this MonitorAgentRow property. That is the architecture, not a conclusion that the row predicate is unreachable. This trace is Puppeteer 748d015a7e393112e0a91dad80111fdf5abe6583 only. It is newer than shipped Vibefield 0.3.3 and does not describe that install. Package comparison was not re-run. Declaration supported from claude-otlp-logs. declaration only; supported does not guarantee availability/value; degraded is not unreachable No raw adapter signal does not rule out the row value from host, runtime, history, or another producer.
